blocks.text: Zscaler recommends using Authentication Service to configure primary and secondary external identity providers (IdPs). Authentication Service supports both SAML and OpenID configurations. Contact Zscaler Support to subscribe to Authentication Service.
You can configure identity providers (IdPs) to support single sign-on (SSO) for users in Zscaler Deception. The IdP providers page allows you to:

blocks.item: Configure SAML for SSO using Okta.
Configure SAML for Active Directory Federation Services.
Configure SAML for Microsoft Azure Active Directory Single Sign-On.
Configure OpenID for SSO using Okta.
Configure OpenID for SSO using Google.

blocks.text: IdPs provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Configure third-party IdPs using OpenID or SAML.
Leverage single authentication using the configured IdPs to allow users to sign in to the Zscaler Deception Admin Portal.

blocks.text: On the IdP Providers page (Settings > Users & Roles > IdP Providers), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Add and configure IdPs to support SSO.
View a list of configured IdPs. For each IdP, you can view:
Name: The name of the IdP configuration.
Issuer: The URL of the IdP issuer.
Enabled: The status of the IdP configuration. The checkmark icon indicates that the IdP is enabled, and the X icon indicates that the IdP is disabled.
Edit or delete a SAML or OpenID IdP.

blocks.text: If Authentication Service is enabled in Deception, you can't configure SSO using third-party IdPs in the Deception Admin Portal. You must configure IdPs in the Zscaler Admin Console.
The existing SSO third-party IdPs are disabled.
To configure IdPs, click the Authentication Service link. You are redirected to the Zscaler Admin Console. To learn more, see About External Identity Providers.
